summary: Search for places and addresses with OpenStreetMap, and open them in Apple Maps.
notes: Searches OpenStreetMap's Nominatim service on nominatim.openstreetmap.org, once per pause in typing, as its usage policy asks. Return opens the place in Apple Maps; Command-Return opens it on openstreetmap.org. Search data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License. Not affiliated with the OpenStreetMap Foundation or Apple.
